name: Música
description: Spotify or YouTube Music in Orkestri: Adicionar > Música opens the player in a card with your own login (kept), playing on in the background; a pill in the canvas corner shows the track with back, play/pause and next; a terminal linked to the card controls it (play, pause, next, what plays). Nothing is downloaded: the services' own web players. Not made or endorsed by Spotify or Google.
